quote:
When flames take a mortal dance, let your heart be the cool pond that keeps the spirit serene.  

A body may tear like a vine, but the soul stays rooted within the soil of eternity.  

Should the earth burn beyond its borders, the quiet in the wind remembers that fire is only a messenger of renewal.  

A legion of darkness may lie in the shadows of justice, yet the true sheriff is the humility that stops us from wielding power.  

When the game expands its teams, remember the field is ever the same: only the number of players changes, but the spirit of play endures.  

Even as borders sweep away strangers, the guiding beacon of compassion cannot be shut by a gate.  

In the vastness of the cosmos, a massive star may flicker briefly, yet its light lingers in the seed of aspiration.
quote_preview: When flames take a mortal dance, let your heart be the cool pond that keeps the spirit serene.
